title: Multispectral imaging for estimating functional tissue parameters
summary: The aim of this study is to investigate whether multispectral imaging can be used to determine certain blood parameters such as oxygenation saturation. In this case multispectral data of skin tissue will be acquired from healthy volunteers. New methods could possibly be derived from this, which could mean a decisive advantage in diagnostics for patients with malignant diseases. In the context of this study, multispectral images are taken of the extremities of healthy volunteers. These data are to be examined in a variety of ways in order to provide clues for future questions.
conditions: Other and unspecified disorders of circulatory system

interventions.name: Multispectral images and spectrometer measurements will be taken from the hands and arms of the participants.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Willingness and ability to participate,
2. Sufficient knowledge of German to understand the subject information and the declaration of consent,
3. Ability to give consent and written consent of the subject,
4. Ability of the subject to assess the nature and scope as well as possible consequences of the clinical study.
Exclusion criteria:
Minors
